newsitem.title: FRANCE: Basque protesters launch hunger strike.
newsitem.headline: Basque protesters launch hunger strike.

text.p: More than 500 Basques from Spain and France launched a week-long hunger strike in seven European cities on Monday to denounce the fate of an equivalent number of Basque prisoners, a separatist group said.

Herri Batasuna (Popular Unity), widely regarded as the political arm of ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) guerrillas said in a statement the 543 fasters were staging their protest in Copenhagen, Berlin, Brussels, Geneva, Rome, Lisbon and Paris.

Herri Batasuna said 543 Basque prisoners were held in French and Spanish jails. It alleged that their basic rights were being systematically violated because of isolation measures, physical attacks and the fact that they were kept far away from their homes.
The number of cities chosen for the protest was a symbol for the seven Basque provinces, three in Spain and four in France.
About 800 people have been killed in Spain in ETA's 27-year guerrilla war for an independent Basque state. A smaller separatist movement, Iparretarrak (Those of the North), is active in France.
